thread_title: S. Adrian slack x Judith Hindle 'Select'
breadcrumb: S. Adrian slack x Judith Hindle 'Select'

posts.body_html:
I've been trying to propagate this plant for years, but every time I get divisions, the second someone finds out, they're gone, so I'm back to square one!

Without a doubt, this plant is worthy of being registered as a cultivar! It has that adrian slack look, but on a judith hindled sized plant. It produces lots of traps throughout the grow season, and is easy to cultivate. Certainly one of a kind, the offspring were all over the place in this cross, and no two looked exactly alike. Maybe this is a plant worthy of naming after my newborn son Benny? I don't know, still not sure...I have an uphill battle since it's going to be hard to create something as eye popping as Ellie Wang. Can't play favorites.

For now, here's S. Adrian Slack x Judith Hindle 'Select' Photos taken 10/23/18:











Here's the plant pictured and grown by one of our members Ps3isawesome, I was hoping he would propagate this plant and distribute it, since I essentially sent him my mother plant back in the day before this clone became well known, but I understand being a vendor isn't for everyone:

It was uprooted and shipped in July, so the fall pitchers were a bit dwarf-ey, but stunning nonetheless. I can't wait to see how she does next year! I certainly think this one is worthy of registration at some point

posts.body_html:
For whatever reason, this clone has never thrived for me. In the interest of making something more reliable, I crossed it with one of my strongest growers, this open pollinated oreophila:

In addition to reliability, I hoped that crossing two stout, colorful, white-topped plants would amplify these traits. I germinated two pots full of seeds over the summer. Fast forward 5-6 months… can you guess which seedling I’m excited about? meizzwang, do you happen to know what your select clone looked like color-wise as a small seedling? I don’t really have a point of reference but this seems freakishly vibrant compared to its neighbors. Also, has anyone else bred with this clone? I’d love to see the results!
